skill.name: video-outpainting
skill.description: Guides video outpainting with RunComfy. It helps users extend a video canvas, change aspect ratio, and preserve the central action.
skill.summary: Extend video frames and change aspect ratios with RunComfy video outpainting workflows.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: The static detections are false positives from Markdown formatting, bounded RunComfy CLI examples, disclosed links, and documented token storage. I found no evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, arbitrary shell execution, or malicious reconnaissance in SKILL.md. The skill still depends on an external RunComfy service, so users should review media privacy before uploading or linking source videos.

remediation.issue: CLI examples include installation and login commands in documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the tool allowlist restricted to Bash(runcomfy *) and keep install steps clearly user-initiated.

remediation.issue: The skill sends or references source video media through an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Continue requiring explicit user-provided URLs and add privacy review guidance for sensitive footage.

remediation.issue: Token storage is documented in a hidden user config path.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the mode 0600 guidance and never instruct agents to read, print, or copy token files.

content.value_statement: Changing video aspect ratios can crop important action or leave empty space. This skill guides RunComfy outpainting workflows that extend the frame while preserving the subject.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Wan 2-7 edit-video for prompt-driven canvas extension.
Provides RunComfy CLI command patterns for video outpainting with JSON input.
Points users to ComfyUI outpainting workflows for higher seam quality.
Includes prompting guidance to preserve central action and match background.
Documents CLI exit codes and common failure conditions.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.
The CLI route is not dedicated outpainting, so seam quality can vary.
Dedicated ComfyUI workflows are GUI-based and not directly reachable from the CLI.
Does not handle image outpainting, temporal extension, or mask-based inpainting.

use_cases.title: Reframe social video
use_cases.description: Convert a vertical short into a horizontal cut without cropping the main subject.

use_cases.title: Prepare brand banners
use_cases.description: Expand square or narrow footage into a wider layout for campaign creative.

use_cases.title: Modernize archive footage
use_cases.description: Choose a higher-quality outpainting route for older 4:3 clips that need 16:9 delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Basic aspect change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner conversion from vertical to horizontal video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use video outpainting to convert this 9:16 clip to 16:9. Preserve the central subject and match the background.

prompt_templates.title: Side extension brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled expansion for a social or internal edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend the canvas on the left and right by about 30 percent each. Keep lighting, camera distance, and motion consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Route selection
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare fast CLI output with higher seam quality needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best RunComfy route for a hero ad outpaint. Explain when Wan 2-7 is enough and when ComfyUI is better.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-pass planning
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced expansion where one pass may not be enough.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a two-pass video outpaint for this clip. Limit each pass, preserve the action, and list quality checks after each output.

output_examples.input: A 9:16 product clip must become a 16:9 website hero video.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a RunComfy edit-video route, a prompt that extends both sides, and a seam quality review step.

output_examples.input: A square Instagram clip needs a wide brand banner format.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests side canvas extension, background matching language, and preserving the original product position.

output_examples.input: An old 4:3 clip needs a polished 16:9 delivery.
output_examples.output: The skill directs the user toward a dedicated ComfyUI outpainting workflow because seam quality is important.

best_practices: Start prompts with the target canvas change and final aspect ratio.
Use only source video URLs that the user explicitly provides.
Choose ComfyUI workflows when delivery requires strong seam consistency.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for adding more time to a video.
Do not send private media to an external service without approval.
Do not repeat large outpaint passes without reviewing quality after each pass.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides RunComfy video outpainting so a video frame can expand beyond its original canvas.

faq.question: Can it change vertical video to horizontal video?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for converting 9:16 clips into 16:9 outputs while preserving the subject.

faq.question: Does it create more time in the video?
faq.answer: No. It expands the spatial frame. Use a video extension workflow for additional frames over time.

faq.question: When should I use a ComfyUI workflow?
faq.answer: Use ComfyUI when seam quality, temporal consistency, or polished campaign delivery is important.

faq.question: Does it require a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI route requires the RunComfy CLI and authentication before running jobs.

faq.question: Will my source video leave my environment?
faq.answer: The workflow uses RunComfy services or user-provided URLs. Review privacy needs before processing sensitive footage.
